## Description

Pricing page on the public site reading the approved plans (MDV-P5-042): Solo, Clinic (most popular), Hospital (talk to us), monthly and yearly toggle with the yearly saving, ₹ or AED by region, 'prices approved' line, payment methods by country. 'Start free trial' goes to sign-up (MDV-P1-004) with the plan chosen. No card needed to start unless the pricing decision says otherwise.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a visitor in the UAE, when opens pricing, then prices show in AED with Apple Pay and cards listed.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a visitor, when chooses Clinic and starts a trial, then sign-up opens with that plan.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given a price changes in the console, when the page reloads, then the new price shows.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
